rationale: Custody finding from real current Checkout: ordinary untracked forensic bytes are fingerprinted and preserved, but ignored dangling-entry collision can be lost during a branch switch; that specific production bug is separately captured with real-Git evidence. Ignore status is not permission to discard evidence. Recovery retains malformed/foreign/unknown owner effects and requires an explicitly stopped process; missing/corrupted initial journals have no automatic safe-reset proof and remain an operator evidence requirement. This audit authorizes no cleanup, abandoned-owner removal, ACL change, historical grant rewrite or archive restoration. All13 original forensic hashes remain preserved.
duplicate_disposition: Existing scope retained; advisory evidence only, no approval, grant, closure or duplicate implementation instruction.
